title: EmbeddingSettings
description:
Personal-edition embedding/vector provider settings (`cap-vector`).

Custom settings are only valid for personal edition: enterprise AI must go through the gateway (C7), and the generated glue never configures a local embedding provider there. `api_key` is write-only in the UI (`settings.get` masks it, like the chat provider key).

dims.description: Requested vector width (1..=65536), when supported by the endpoint.
